# Opello

> The Opello website build: a full pre-launch preview served as an unlisted studio preview at /studio/ while the product is in development. The public domain (https://opello.co.uk/) is still a coming-soon page. This preview is marked noindex and carries a "not for publication until approved" marker on every page; wording is draft and may change before launch. Pages are server-rendered HTML in three languages: English, Arabic (RTL) and Turkish.

## Facts

- Name: Opello
- Status: pre-launch build preview (noindex, unlisted, not for publication)
- Domain: opello.co.uk (public site is a coming-soon page; the build lives at /studio/)
- First-release product scope: personal GBP e-money accounts, domestic and international GBP payments, a virtual card for spending worldwide, savings pots, refer-a-friend
- Customer-residence markets: UK, UAE and Türkiye (onboarding scope still being confirmed)
- Languages: English (/studio/), Arabic RTL (/studio/ar/), Turkish (/studio/tr/). Every page has a twin in each language at /studio/{lang}/{slug}/
- Draft copy: product wording is under review; contact details, app links and social accounts are placeholders until they are set up
